reviews.title: Great board for the price
reviews.comment: Great quality board. I love the rotary knob and the backlight. I do wish you could turn it off completely, so far I've only figured out how to switch between key backlight + side lights, just backlight, and just side lights. I got this refurbished and it included everything in the box and didn't seem like it had been used at all. Everything was clean, no scratches, no missing documentation or accessories. One thing I have noticed is the right function key doesn't seem to register on my mac even though it does work for accessing keyboard settings, so I expect there's a setting or configuration I need to change for this and not an issue with the board itself. I love the silver aluminum color. It's not white, it's definitely a light metallic silver. I have this paired with some Durock Ice King switches and some cheap Amazon keycaps, and it's a great typing experience.
reviews.author: Zach

reviews.title: The first one looked used
reviews.comment: Order this frame for my son. Opened it and everything seemed fine. Installed switches and he hooked it up to his computer and found out some of the keys were working. So we swapped out the switches, still not working. Requested a replacement and got it the next day (quick and easy). When opening the package of the replacement, compared to the other this one didn’t look like it had been opened before, frame in a plastic bag. I think someone bought and returned the first one we got. Maybe a little better QC team to ensure this doesn’t happen with that same one we returned.
reviews.author: Jeremy Ruffe

reviews.title: Needs some tweaks but it's perfect
reviews.comment: Buy the glorious V2 or better stabilizers. Be sure to lube up your new stabilizers. The pre installed ones are bad. Be sure to update firmware with glorious core and then you can flash qmk to be compatible with signalrgb. This board is excellent value. With the updates and new stabilizers it sounds very good. I have silent switches and it feels and sounds perfect.
reviews.author: Jonathan.B

reviews.title: Did not come working
reviews.comment: Did not come working, unfortunately. the weight is perfect, and I like the sound of the lynx switched I got, but it needs to be able to work for it to matter.
reviews.author: Pearl

reviews.title: Heavy and solid keyboard
reviews.comment: The build quality is ridiculously good, it’s like a keyboard inside a block of marble. That being said, it is super heavy - which is also a good thing.
